sentences.text: Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. By way of the present appeal, the appellant assails the judgment dated 27th July, 2023 in terms of which the appellant had been convicted for offences under Section 376 read with Sections 511/420/406/506/493/494/495/496 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and the order on sentence dated 18th September, 2023 whereby the appellant was sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten years for conviction under Section 376 IPC.

4. Admit.
5.
List in due course.
6. Trial Court record be requisitioned.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 11/11/2023 at 10:10:51 CRL.M.A. 31074/2023 (suspension of sentence)
7.
By way of the present application, the appellant seeks suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

sentences.text: 8. Issue Notice.
9. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.

10. Considering the nature of the offence, the Investigating Officer (IO) will inform the victim in writing regarding the present application so as to enable her to be present in Court personally or through counsel, if she so desires.
11. Status Report be filed.

12. Nominal Roll be requisitioned from the Jail Superintendent and placed on record before the next date of hearing.
13.
List on 29th January, 2024.
CRL.M.A. 31073/2023 (Addl. docs.)
14. The present application has been filed seeking permission to take on record certain documents which were not permitted to be taken on record by the Trial Court.
15. Issue Notice.
16. Notice is accepted by the learned APP appearing on behalf of the State.
17. Reply be filed before the next date of hearing.

18. List on 29th January, 2024.
AMIT BANSAL, J NOVEMBER 10, 2023/sr
